blockingFindings.description: Direct review of all five current views shows a plain ivory fitted jacket with a broad flat lavender diagonal panel, sparse buttons and oversized elbow diamonds; torso surfaces remain visibly faceted.

The split skirt now has a clearer center seam, but the standing silhouette is still a simple flared shell with coarse vertical folds rather than the short, articulated pleated practice skirt in the concept.

Current crouch and sit images expose substantial shorts and show stiff triangular skirt flares beside and behind the thighs. Same-pose overskirt ray coverage is crouch 0.5548/0.5729, sit 0.4542/0.4497 (left/right upper thigh); this is prototype geometry evidence only.
Prone render compresses the skirt into a wide, irregular fan with angular folds; neutral, crouch and seated renders also show uneven faceted drape.
Arms-up and arm-cross images retain visible sleeve/underarm faceting; elbow diamonds remain large surface decals rather than restrained quilted patches.
Rear and side views retain a featureless back and abrupt waist-to-skirt transition; no convincing back adjustment or finished panel detail is visible.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
